mapper.insert: insert into user_coupon (user_id, coupon_id, status, used_time, request_id, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{couponId}, #{status}, #{usedTime}, #{requestId}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select id from user_coupon where request_id = #{requestId}

select uc.id as userCouponId, c.id as couponId, c.name, c.discount_type as discountType, c.discount, c.begin_time as beginTime, c.end_time as endTime, uc.status from user_coupon uc left join coupon c on uc.coupon_id = c.id where uc.user_id = #{userId} order by uc.id desc

select uc.id as userCouponId, c.id as couponId, c.name, c.discount_type as discountType, c.discount, c.begin_time as beginTime, c.end_time as endTime, uc.status from user_coupon uc left join coupon c on uc.coupon_id = c.id where uc.user_id = #{userId} and uc.status = 0 and now() between c.begin_time and c.end_time order by uc.id desc
mapper.update: update user_coupon set status = 0, used_time = null where id = #{id} and status = 1
